## Requirements

1. The replay/checker packaging: the cross-candidate harness updated to
   the current committed corpora and verified self-checking over E1
   (in-repo, hermetic) — landable without H3.
2. Where H3 exists: foreign cells run + record measured output — H3 is
   NOT provisioned, so every unrun cell keeps its DF row OPEN with a
   dated environment-pending note + compensating control.
3. DF rows carry dated progress/environment-pending lines reflecting
   only what truly ran.

## Acceptance criteria (from the ticket)

- [ ] packaged replay harness self-checks green over E1 in-repo
      *(deterministic · fixture-verified)*
- [ ] foreign cells run where H3 exists; else dated environment-pending
      notes — zero fabricated passes *(agentic · fixture-verified ceiling)*
- [ ] DF-S0.3-2/-S1.2-2/-S1.5-3/-S1.8-1/-S1.27-1 dated lines reflecting
      only what ran *(agentic)*
- [ ] universal phase-gate AC *(agentic)*

## Plan

New workspace crate `hh-xcheck` — the durable cross-implementation
replay/checker packaging (the S0.3b throwaway machinery's landed form):
exports the committed golden corpora as a language-neutral
`hh-xcheck-bundle/1` replay bundle (identity trees+records, ledger WAL
transcript, registry snapshot corpus, plugin-manifest corpus, a
canonical-parse timing corpus at 16/64 KiB), runs the E1 self-check over
it hermetically, and carries the comparator (`verify`) the foreign
implementation's answers will be checked against when HUMAN-H3 lands.
`hh-identity` gains additive fixture accessors (`Tree::entries`/
`canonical_json`, `corpus::golden_*_fixtures`) so the bundle serializes
the corpus *inputs*, never a re-derivation (CC1).

## Test matrix

- export determinism + committed-bundle drift pin (regenerate == committed)
- E1 self-check green per arm over the committed bundle
- tamper negative tests (mutated input/expected fails — never vacuous)
- verify(): correct foreign answers pass; wrong/missing named cases fail
- manifest lists the environment-pending foreign cells honestly
